QF.id: Registration, Code of Conduct and General Obligations_13

question.text: An existing merchant banker wants to conduct non-SEBI regulated activities after the Amendment Regulations 2025. Within what time frame must it transfer such activities to Strategic Business Units (SBUs)?

explanation.text: The Logic: Existing MBs must transfer their non-SEBI regulated activities to Strategic Business Units (SBUs) within 6 months of the Amendment Regulations 2025 coming into effect. SBUs ensure proper segregation and ring-fencing of these activities. The Trap: 12 months might seem like a reasonable transition period, but the regulation is more stringent at 6 months to ensure swift compliance with the new framework.
